mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.student_id, r.trigger_type, r.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommendation_item i JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = i.job_posting_id WHERE i.recommendation_id = r.id AND j.is_active = 1) AS item_count FROM recommendation r WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.rank_no, i.response, CAST(i.reasons AS CHAR) AS reasons, j.id AS job_posting_id, j.company_name, j.title, j.location, j.employment_type, j.career, j.deadline_on, j.until_filled FROM recommendation_item i JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = i.job_posting_id WHERE i.recommendation_id = #{recommendationId} ORDER BY i.rank_no
SELECT DISTINCT i.job_posting_id FROM recommendation_item i JOIN recommendation r ON r.id = i.recommendation_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND i.response <> 'NONE'
SELECT id FROM job_posting WHERE is_active = 1 AND id IN #{jid}
